reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
summary: After the drawer’s shown event, focus moves to the first focusable element inside it, so keyboard focus no longer falls back to the body.
caveats: The selector list does not prefer an [autofocus] element and does not skip disabled or hidden controls.
Focus moves only after the slide-in transition ends; the pending human fix in #43139 instead fixes the visibility timing so the native dialog focusing steps work.
